instrument.state: An internal structure cannot be sampled directly, but variations within it systematically alter the propagation of signals that cross it along many paths.
instrument.operation: Measure signal travel behavior across many source-to-receiver paths, compare those observations with predictions from a candidate internal model, and iteratively adjust the model to reduce the discrepancies.
instrument.signal: The observed propagation times or waveforms differ from model predictions in spatially structured ways across the sampled paths.
instrument.inference: The pattern of discrepancies constrains a spatial model of internal properties that could have produced the observed propagation behavior.
instrument.limit: Sparse or uneven path coverage, measurement error, uncertain source locations, regularization choices, model assumptions, and non-uniqueness can create artifacts or allow multiple internal structures to fit the observations.

target.question: Where do approval handoffs accumulate delay, and which bounded changes could reduce it?
evidence: Authored synthetic scenario; no claim about a real organization or person.

A synthetic ticket-routing testbed uses known overlapping team routes; only endpoint timestamps are exposed. Tagged tickets have identical workload. Repeated runs and injected waits validate additive traversal times within this low-load testbed.

mapping.state: Internal team waiting properties cannot be directly observed but affect traversal times across many known paths.
mapping.operation: Route timed test tickets across overlapping team paths, predict end-to-end times from candidate internal wait maps, and iteratively invert residuals to adjust those maps.
mapping.signal: Path-structured timing discrepancies constrain which hidden stages contribute delay.
mapping.inference: Localize possible internal waiting-time structure and identify candidate handoff interventions within the validated testbed regime.
mapping.limit: Coverage, variable service times, uncertain routing, regularization and non-uniqueness limit inference; testbed effects may not generalize to live queues.
